regions.name: coat
regions.notes: 2026-10-09 lane B (user: black splotches over the pegasi in game): the unit-level v7c grade crushed the AO-occluded coat and feather texels to black (see pegasus_segment.py, armoured pegasi). The raw albedo's pale texels (sat < 0.20, value > 0.45), minus the wing-bone, gold-hued and warm texels (pegasus_segment.build_armoured_masks), take the CAPEGS white coat palette by rank, as h3_pegasus.

regions.name: wing
regions.notes: 2026-10-09 lane B: the feathers rank on their own onto the DEF's brightest, cooler pale pixels (h3_pegasus wing region); the other masks have the wing-bone texels cut out.

regions.name: armour
regions.notes: 2026-10-09 lane B (coordinator: keep the barding on its own DEF palette, gold not white): the raw gold-hued texels (hue 35-70, sat >= 0.20; the barding is the only gold material) take the gold trim (DEF 'armour' = the gold-hued pixels, closed; the dark checker it frames stays on the unit-level grade with the hooves and outline) by rank.

regions.name: rider
regions.notes: 2026-10-09 lane B: the warm raw texels that are not gold-hued (rider skin, hair, leather, the brown rear blanket) take the DEF rider's peach tan and dark leather by rank (h3_pegasus rider region).
